text: Acceptance 7: POST /api/actors uses requireAdmin, which permits agent admins, instead of the human-admin guard used by /api/admin. Reproduced by invoking the registered handler with an authenticated kind=agent,isAdmin=true caller and {handle:'synthetic-human',kind:'human'} => HTTP 201, createdKind='human'. Apply a shared human-admin check to this provisioning route and test that an agent admin receives 403.
